title: Venice
completionText: Venice slips behind you in mist. The Alps loom. Paris is half a continent away, but you have come this far.

cards.dialogue: "The gondola threads the lagoon at dawn. Saint Mark's domes rise from the water like an Eastern dream. A gondolier asks where you wish to lodge."
cards.leftText: Your rooms smell of fish and ink. The Rialto bustles below; you are inside the city's heart.
cards.rightText: A small palazzo opens its shutters for you. Casanova himself is rumoured to dine downstairs.
